import pytest

@pytest.mark.parametrize(

    ],
)
def test_camel_to_snake_happy_path(input_value: str, expected: str) -> None:

    ("input_value", "expected"),
    [
        ("", ""),
        ("a", "a"),
        ("A", "a"),
        ("UPPERCASE", "uppercase"),
        ("HTTPServerError", "httpserver_error"),
        ("parseHTTPResponse", "parse_httpresponse"),
        ("XMLHttpRequest", "xmlhttp_request"),

        ("caféTest", "cafétest"),
    ],
)
def test_camel_to_snake_edge_cases(input_value: str, expected: str) -> None:

        [],
